company-underwriting.financialOperatingTrajectory: Q2 revenue $191.9M versus $103.0M YoY; GAAP net loss widened to $22.8M and GAAP gross margin was 27.7%.
company-underwriting.balanceSheet: Rapid leased-capacity expansion and equity issuance capacity create fixed-cost and dilution risk.
company-underwriting.customersContracts: 800G/1.6T demand was reported above production capacity through mid-2027; customer-level committed mix remains incompletely quantified.
company-underwriting.governanceCapitalAllocation: Capacity investment addresses observed demand but utilization, yield and dilution discipline remain execution tests.
company-underwriting.pricingPowerConcentration: Capacity tightness supports moderate pricing power while concentration and architecture shifts constrain confidence.

thesisQuality.basis: Record revenue and AI-optics demand support adoption, offset by losses and architecture risk.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Revenue nearly doubled YoY while GAAP loss widened and gross margin weakened.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Market pricing embeds substantial AI-optics growth while GAAP profitability remains absent.

catalystScore.basis: Concrete production ramp and demand above capacity through mid-2027 provide timed catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Capacity investment addresses demand but losses, dilution exposure and ramp risk keep evidence mixed.

alignment2036.basis: High-speed optical interconnect is critical infrastructure for AI/data-center compute.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Optical manufacturing serves data-center/networking channels with meaningful concentration remaining.

bottleneckControl.basis: Demand exceeds available 800G/1.6T production and qualified capacity is expanding.

scenarioRobustness.basis: AI bandwidth growth supports demand but fixed-capacity expansion and concentration create scenario dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: Qualification capability creates moderate barriers while alternative architectures/vendors remain credible.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Capacity is expanding, but yield, redundancy and supplier contingency evidence remain incomplete.

pricingPower.basis: Demand above production supports scarcity rent while concentration and weaker GAAP margin limit a stronger band.

riskEvidence.basis: Losses, margin pressure, rapid capacity expansion, concentration, substitution and dilution create high execution risk.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current primary financial/capacity evidence supports factors; commitments, yield and supply redundancy remain incomplete.

scoreRecord.thesis: AAOI is scaling scarce high-speed optical capacity into strong AI-cluster bandwidth demand, with value dependent on durable GAAP margins without excessive dilution.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Capacity expansion can outrun qualified demand/yields while optical architectures evolve.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Progress toward production targets and GAAP margin/cash conversion.

contradictions.claim: Record revenue versus wider GAAP loss and lower GAAP gross margin.
contradictions.resolution: Both retained; scale acceleration is real but durable GAAP economics remain unproven.

unknowns.item: Customer-level committed demand, qualified yields and supplier redundancy are not fully disclosed.
